cli.server_help:
{binary} {version}

Usage: {binary} [options]

Information:
  -h, --help                     Show help
  -v, --version                  Show version
  --status                       Show server status and health (exit 0 = healthy)
  --yes                          Skip supported confirmation prompts

Shell Integration:
  --shell completions [SHELL]    Print shell completions
  --shell init [SHELL]           Print shell init command
  --shell help                   Show shell help

Server Configuration:
  --mode {production|development} Application mode (default: production)
  --config DIR                   Config directory
  --data DIR                     Data directory
  --cache DIR                    Cache directory
  --log DIR                      Log directory
  --backup DIR                   Backup directory
  --pid FILE                     PID file path
  --address ADDR                 Listen address (default: [::])
  --port PORT                    Listen port (default: random 64xxx, 80 in container)
  --baseurl PATH                 URL path prefix (default: /)
  --i2p                          Enable the I2P eepsite
  --daemon                       Run as daemon (detach from terminal)
  --debug                        Enable debug mode
  --color {auto|yes|no}          Color output (default: auto)
  --lang CODE                    Language for output (default: auto)

Service Commands:
  --service start       Start the service
  --service stop        Stop the service
  --service restart     Restart the service
  --service reload      Reload configuration
  --service status      Show service status
  --service --install   Install as system service
  --service --uninstall Remove system service

Maintenance Commands:
  --maintenance backup [file]   Backup configuration and data
  --maintenance backup test [FILE] Verify the archived PGP keypair without restoring
  --maintenance restore [file]  Restore from backup
  --maintenance update          Check for and install updates
  --maintenance pgp <action>    Manage the project security keypair
  --maintenance security list|show|update  Manage disclosure report metadata (root)
  --maintenance token list          List owner token metadata
  --maintenance token revoke PREFIX Revoke a token (requires confirmation)
  --maintenance data export|delete  Export or delete owner data
  --maintenance compliance report   Show compliance summary

Update Commands:
  --update check                Check for updates
  --update yes                  Install latest update
  --update branch BRANCH        {update_branch_usage}

Scheduler Commands:
  scheduler list                List all scheduled tasks and status
  scheduler show <id>           Show task details
  scheduler run <id>            Run a task immediately
  scheduler enable <id>         Enable a task
  scheduler disable <id>        Disable a task
  scheduler history <id>        Show a task's last recorded run

Email Commands:
  email test [recipient]        Send a test email to verify SMTP
  email status                  Show SMTP configuration and reachability
  email validate                Validate all email templates

Environment Variables (runtime):
  PORT           Server port
  LISTEN         Listen address
  MODE           Application mode
  DOMAIN         FQDN override
  SMTP_HOST      SMTP server host (overrides config)
  SMTP_PORT      SMTP server port (default 587)
  SMTP_USERNAME  SMTP auth username
  SMTP_PASSWORD  SMTP auth password
  SMTP_TLS       TLS mode: auto, starttls, tls, none
  SMTP_FROM_NAME Envelope From display name
  SMTP_FROM_EMAIL Envelope From address

Environment Variables (init-only, first run):
  CONFIG_DIR    Configuration directory
  DATA_DIR      Data directory
  DATABASE_DIR Database directory (default: {data}/db)
  CACHE_DIR     Cache directory
  LOG_DIR      Log directory
  BACKUP_DIR   Backup directory

Configuration:
  Root:    /etc/apimgr/gitignore/server.yml
  User:    ~/.config/apimgr/gitignore/server.yml
  Docker:  /config/server.yml

client.help:
{binary} {version} - CLI for gitignore

Usage:
  {binary} [command] [args] [flags]
  # interactive mode (no args)
  {binary}

Commands:
  list                          List all template names
  search QUERY                  Search templates by name/tag
  categories                    List categories
  category NAME                 List templates in a category
  get NAME | template NAME       Print a single template
  combine NAME...                Merge templates (default when args are bare names)
  stats                         Show server template statistics

Flags:
-h, --help                             - Show help
-v, --version                           - Show version
--shell completions [SHELL]            - Print shell completions (auto-detect if SHELL omitted)
--shell init [SHELL]                   - Print shell init command (auto-detect if SHELL omitted)
--shell help                           - Show shell integration help

--server URL                           - Server URL (default: from cli.yml)
--config NAME                          - Config profile name (default: cli)
--output {text|json|table}              - Output format (default: text)
--debug                                - Debug output
--color {auto|yes|no}                  - Color output (default: auto)
--lang CODE                            - Language for output (default: auto)

Shells: bash, zsh, fish, sh, dash, ksh, powershell, pwsh

Run without arguments for interactive mode.
Examples:
  {binary} Go Node > .gitignore
  {binary} search python
  {binary} get Go --output json

about.intro: GitIgnore provides curated templates for languages, frameworks, editors, and tools through a versioned REST API, a GraphQL endpoint, and a server-rendered web interface.
about.feature_curated: Curated .gitignore templates for languages, editors, frameworks, and operating system patterns.
about.feature_retrieve: Retrieve a single template by name, without regard to letter case.
about.feature_combine: Combine multiple templates into one output.
about.feature_cli: Use the gitignore-cli companion from shell pipelines.
about.feature_compatibility: Drop-in compatible with the gitignore.io and Toptal gitignore API.
about.feature_browse: Browse templates by category, search by name, and view statistics.
about.feature_docs: OpenAPI and GraphQL documentation for API clients.
about.embedded: Templates are embedded in the binary, so no separate template service is needed. Optional GeoIP support downloads its databases and refreshes them through the scheduler.
about.data_handling_description: GitIgnore has no user registration or profile pages. Owners are anonymous identities represented by owner tokens; operator actions require an operator token. Catalog endpoints are public. Contact and security reports may include the identity, contact details, and report information their sender submits. Request metadata may be processed for abuse prevention, rate limiting, and optional GeoIP lookup; instance operators control their own access logs.

handler.default_help_content: Use the catalog API to list, search, retrieve, combine, and export curated .gitignore templates. Template names are case-insensitive. See the API reference for route and response details.
handler.default_security_policy_content:
## Reporting a vulnerability

Report security vulnerabilities privately through GitHub private vulnerability reporting or the security report form. Include the affected version, impact, and reproduction steps. Do not publish vulnerability details before coordinating disclosure.

## Response process

Receipt is acknowledged within 48 hours. Critical vulnerabilities are targeted for a fix within 14 days. The disclosure timeline is coordinated after a fix is available. Only the latest release receives security updates.
handler.api_about_description: GitIgnore is a curated .gitignore template service with a public REST API, read-only GraphQL API, MCP tools, server-rendered browser interface, and companion CLI. Templates are embedded in the binary and can be retrieved individually, searched, or combined.

privacy.data_collection:
**We collect only what is necessary to provide our service:**

**Usage Information (with consent):**
- Pages visited and features used
- Browser type and device information
- Approximate location (country/region from IP, not precise)

**Technical Information:**
- IP address (for security and abuse prevention)
- API token identifiers (hashed, never stored in plain text)

**We do NOT collect:**
- Payment information (unless explicitly required by the service)
- Precise location data
- Data from other websites or apps
privacy.data_usage:
**Your data is used solely to:**

- **Provide the service:** Authentication, core functionality
- **Improve the experience:** Performance optimization, bug fixes, feature improvements
- **Ensure security:** Prevent abuse, detect fraud, protect the service
- **Communicate:** Service updates, security alerts, and (with consent) product news

**Your data is NEVER:**
- Sold to third parties
- Used for targeted advertising
- Shared without your explicit consent (except as required by law)
privacy.data_usage_if_sold:
**Your data may be used to:**

- **Provide the service:** Authentication, core functionality
- **Improve the experience:** Performance optimization, bug fixes, feature improvements
- **Ensure security:** Prevent abuse, detect fraud, protect the service
- **Communicate:** Service updates, security alerts, and (with consent) product news
- **Third-party sharing:** Your data may be shared with or sold to third parties for analytics, advertising, or other purposes as described below

**Your rights:**
- You can opt out of data sales with the CCPA opt-out on the preferences page (`/server/preferences`)
- You can delete the resources you created at any time with your owner token, and request deletion of other data through the contact details on the privacy page
- See "Your Rights" section below for details
privacy.data_security:
**How we protect your data:**

- All data is stored on our servers (not third-party cloud services unless specified)
- API tokens are stored as SHA-256 hashes (never in plain text)
- All connections are encrypted (HTTPS/TLS)
- Regular security audits and updates
- Access controls and audit logging for operator actions
privacy.retention_period: Resources you create are kept until they expire or you delete them with your owner token. Preferences are stored only in cookies in your browser. Operational logs are kept for up to 30 days. Anonymized analytics data may be retained for up to 12 months.
